posts.text:
@jonkarl has now conducted two dawning interviews with two socialists (AOC, Mamdani) in the past two weeks while never once challenging anything these people are claiming. 

Mamdani: We’re providing free childcare for 2-year-olds: 

Fact: Nope. Not yet. and when it is launched this fall- it will only be offered to 2000 families. 

Mamdani: We froze rents to make housing more affordable. 

Fact: Rent hit an all-time high for the past two months since Mamdani froze rents. 

Jon- seriously - just o
posts.summary: Accuses journalist of softball interviewing socialists without fact-checking claims

posts.text:
The question/premise isn’t the story here, it’s the fact that @edokeefe didn’t ask the most obvious follow-up question to the governor: “So do you believe that socialist policies are the answer to all of the alleged issues you listed?” 

But Ed allowed him to filibuster anyway.
